# .NET 11 and Node.js 26 LTS are generally available on Azure App Service for Windows

## What Changed

.NET 11 and Node.js 26 Long Term Support (LTS) are now generally available on Azure App Service for Windows. You can use these runtimes for production applications, whether you’re creating a new app or upgrading an existing workload.

## Why It Matters to a CSA

A generally available capability may remove a blocker or create an expansion opportunity.

## Customer Impact

**Medium**. Lifecycle: `ga`. Change type: `new`.

## Recommended Action

Confirm regional availability and evaluate it against active customer architectures.
